narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The triangle has three sides, so there are only three quadrilaterals.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Look at the twelve centimetre side. The turned copy and the flipped copy make different shapes.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Each side gives two joins, not one.

<bookmark mark='two'/>Flip it over along a side, and you get a kite.
